Script executed: ```bash rg -n 'google-generativeai|google\.generativeai|importorskip|test_gemini' packages/dbgpt-core/pyproject.toml pyproject.toml packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests .github ``` Repository: eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT Length of output: 263 --- Script executed: ```bash set -u echo "== gemini.py head ==" nl -ba packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/gemini.py | sed -n '1,60p' echo "== gemini.py google imports / genai usage ==" rg -n -F -e 'google' -e 'genai' -- packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/gemini.py || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "== all google-generativeai declarations ==" rg -n -F -e 'google-generativeai' -e 'google_generativeai' -- . || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "== conftest / skip mechanisms near tests ==" rg --files -g 'conftest.py' packages/dbgpt-core packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy || test "$?" -eq 1 rg -n -e 'importorskip' -e 'collect_ignore' -e 'pytest.mark.skip' -e 'skipif' -- packages/dbgpt-core packages/dbgpt-ext/src/dbgpt_ext/llm 2>/dev/null || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "== proxy tests directory ==" rg --files packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "== CI test install commands ==" rg -n -e 'pytest' -e 'uv sync' -e 'pip install' -e 'extra' -- .github 2>/dev/null || test "$?" -eq 1 ``` Repository: eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT Length of output: 4850 ---
**Skip the Gemini tests when `google-generativeai` is missing.** `_generation_config` imports `google.generativeai` on every call. The package is not declared in any dependency file, and no skip guard covers this test module. Without the package, all four tests fail with `ModuleNotFoundError` before they reach the configuration assertions. Use `pytest.importorskip` in the helper so these tests skip when the SDK is absent.
Suggested fix
```diff --- "a/packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_gemini.py" +++ "b/packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_gemini.py" @@ -8,8 +8,8 @@ from dbgpt.model.proxy.llms.gemini import GeminiLLMClient def _generation_config(request: ModelRequest) -> dict: - import google.generativeai as genai + genai = pytest.importorskip("google.generativeai") client = GeminiLLMClient(model="gemini-2.0-flash", api_key="test-key") chunk = MagicMock() ```
As per path instructions, `保持单元测试确定且隔离，不依赖真实网络、外部模型、数据库、GPU、Docker、wall-clock time 或开发者机器状态` (keep unit tests deterministic and isolated, and do not depend on developer machine state). This test depends on a locally installed SDK that the repository does not declare.
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion genai = pytest.importorskip("google.generativeai") client = GeminiLLMClient(model="gemini-2.0-flash", api_key="test-key") ```

Summary
### Purpose and implementation The change forwards `request.top_p` to Gemini when it is set. It omits `top_p` when unset and removes the forced `top_k=1`, leaving `top_k` to the Gemini API default. ### Scope and interfaces The change affects the Gemini proxy client in `dbgpt-core` and adds tests for its generation configuration. It does not change public APIs or deployment parameters. ### Risks The Gemini API default for `top_k` now controls sampling when callers do not specify it. The change introduces no other concrete correctness, security, compatibility, or performance risks evident from the implementation. ### Tests and verification The new tests cover forwarding configured `top_p`, omitting unset `top_p`, retaining `temperature`, and not setting `top_k`. The author reports that the targeted tests pass, along with Ruff checks. To verify, run: ```bash pytest packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_gemini.py ruff check packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/gemini.py packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_gemini.py ruff format --check packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/gemini.py packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_gemini.py ``` Gemini streaming generation no longer sets `top_k` or a default `top_p`. It includes `top_p` only when the request specifies a value.
